# Day 5 — Intro to Advanced Topics

Day 5 — Intro to Advanced Topics / AI. Math covers sampling
distributions, the law of large numbers and central limit theorem,
frequentist vs. Bayesian inference, and causality — a bridge into
first-year coursework. Programming covers coding with AI.

This session has two parts:

- **[Math Session](slides.qmd)** — the in-class slideshow.
- **[Programming Session](programming.qmd)** — a webpage walking through the
  same material with runnable R code.
